spec.scope: Generic critRatePct (no 'normal attacks' scoping in the text) — 0.75% per stack, cap 100 (75% crit at cap).
spec.durationSemantics: 'continuously' = no time expiry; stack pool persists until explicitly removed at Full Burst end (s1 line 3). NOT durationSec, NOT durationShots.
spec.triggerIdentity: lastBullet (per-magazine, owner fires the final round). Each activation grants +29 stacks ('Tilted Scale stacks ▲ 29'), so cap is reached in 4 activations (29→58→87→100), not 100 activations.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Granting +1 stack per lastBullet (cap after 100 reloads — never reached) OR misreading 'stacks ▲ 29' as raising the cap to 129 OR giving the buff a wall-clock durationSec.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: onEvent buffApply filter stat==='critRatePct' && value===0.75 for slug k: first lastBullet emits stacks===29; after the 4th lastBullet within one FB cycle stacks===100 (capped, maxStacks 100 — never 116, never 129); expiresFrame indicates no natural time expiry.
spec.inertness: No critRatePct buffApply targets any ally (self-only); stack count never exceeds 100.

spec.scope: Flat-damage rider on the enemy, 23.9% of final ATK. Rider takes FB by timing (default ON), no core, crit-eligibility per rider convention.
spec.triggerIdentity: CRIT-COUNT trigger: fires every 4 CRITICAL hits landed (hitsPerShot 2 → 2 crit rolls per pull). The schema's hitCount counts ROUNDS unconditionally — there is NO crit-count trigger primitive and no requiresCrit gate visible. Proc cadence must scale with the LIVE crit rate, which itself ramps with Tilted Scale (0.75%×stacks, sawtoothed by FB-end removal) — a fixed hitCount threshold cannot express this without a ⚑ calibrated effective count.
spec.nearestWrongModel: hitCount:{count:4} counting ALL rounds — at ~40 hits/s this over-fires by 3–10× early fight when crit is ~15–35%, and misses the ramp (proc rate should roughly triple as stacks approach cap).
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Count damage events with mult≈23.9 && srcSlot==='skill1' in the pre-first-FB window: the count must approximate (critRate×hits)/4 given the stack trajectory (order tens), NOT hits/4 (order hundreds). Green under crit-gated cadence, red under plain hitCount:4.
spec.inertness: Proc count must respond to crit-rate changes: under withPatchedOverride removing the s1 crit stacks, the 23.9% proc count must DROP — a round-count model would be invariant.

spec.kitLine: Full Burst ends: Removes Tilted Scale
spec.durationSemantics: Event-keyed removal — the stack pool is a SAWTOOTH: rebuild via reloads between FBs, wiped at every fullBurstEnd. Not expressible as durationSec (FB cycle length varies).
spec.triggerIdentity: fullBurstEnd (ANY team FB end — no own-burst qualifier in the text).
spec.nearestWrongModel: Omitting removal entirely (crit sits at capped 75% for the whole fight after ~4 magazines — large over-credit) OR removing at FB START (strips the crit during the highest-damage window, under-credit). NOTE: the effect schema exposes no remove-named-buff EffectDef; if the engine truly lacks the primitive this is an engine-core gap, not an authoring choice.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: After each fullBurstEnd event, the NEXT critRatePct/0.75 buffApply for k must show stacks===29 (restart from zero), not a refresh at stacks===100; and k's crit-bearing damage events inside FB windows must reflect the stacks accrued THAT cycle.
spec.inertness: Stacks must NOT persist across FB boundaries; removal must NOT fire at fullBurstStart.

spec.scope: maxAmmoPct −51.13 on ALL ALLIES. This is DAMAGE (taxonomy #6): 120→~58 magazine for k, and every ally reloads ~2× as often (more reload downtime = less ally damage). It also FEEDS BACK into k's own loop — shorter magazines → more frequent lastBullet → faster Tilted Scale stacking and more skill2 refreshes. Do NOT skip as 'defensive/ammo-only'.
spec.durationSemantics: 10 s wall-clock, refreshed on every stack gain ('Similar effects cannot be stacked' = non-stacking refresh, same-key overwrite). With a ~59-round magazine (~3 s) + 129f reload, refresh period ≈ 5 s < 10 s → near-permanent uptime once rolling.
spec.triggerIdentity: 'when gaining Tilted Scale' — fires iff s1's stack grant fires, i.e. co-keyed to k's lastBullet. No 'ally gains buff' trigger exists in the schema; the faithful encoding rides the SAME lastBullet trigger. First magazine is FULL 120 (skill2 dormant until the first lastBullet).
spec.nearestWrongModel: Dropping Effect 1 as non-damage and keeping only the +10.62% (misses both the ally-reload penalty and k's self-acceleration), or scoping the ammo cut to self only, or keying to fullBurstEnter/interval.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: After k's first reload, buffApply stat==='maxAmmoPct' value===-51.13 exists for ALL FIVE targetIdx; ally reload-event count over the fight is ~2× the count under withPatchedOverride('k', strip Effect 1); k's own lastBullet cadence tightens after the first magazine (first reload at ~120 rounds, subsequent at ~58–59).
spec.inertness: First magazine consumes the full 120 rounds; no ammo buffApply before the first lastBullet.

spec.scope: attackDamagePct (Damage-Up bucket, additive, diluted with other team Damage-Up) +10.62 — generic, all attack damage.
spec.durationSemantics: 10 s wall-clock, non-stacking refresh (same buff key as Effect 1's package; refresh:true on re-apply).
spec.triggerIdentity: Same trigger as Effect 1 — k's lastBullet (via Tilted Scale gain).
spec.nearestWrongModel: Encoding as stacking (each refresh adds 10.62 — 'cannot be stacked' forbids it) or as passive/always-on from t=0 (it is dormant until k's first reload ~6 s in, and dark after FB end until the next reload).
spec.distinguishingAssertion: buffApply stat==='attackDamagePct' value===10.62 targets all 5 units with refresh===true on re-application (never stacks>1); no such buffApply exists before k's first reload event.
spec.inertness: Ally damage events before k's first lastBullet carry no 10.62 Damage-Up contribution.

spec.kitLine: FB ends: Removes Fulfillment of Righteous.
spec.scope: Removal of BOTH effects (ammo ▼ and attack damage ▲) from all allies at Full Burst end.
spec.durationSemantics: Event-keyed early termination of the 10 s window. Net effect window: allies regain full magazines and lose +10.62% between fullBurstEnd and k's next lastBullet (a few seconds).
spec.nearestWrongModel: Letting the 10 s duration run past FB end (over-credits ~10.62% Damage-Up and keeps allies' magazines halved for the residual window). Same schema concern as s1 line 3: no remove-buff EffectDef is visible — may share the engine-primitive gap.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Ally damage events in the (fullBurstEnd → k's next lastBullet) gap carry NO 10.62 attackDamagePct contribution, and an ally magazine that reloads in that gap fills to its UNREDUCED max.
spec.inertness: Removal must not fire mid-FB; the buffs re-establish on k's next reload.

spec.scope: weaponSwap for 10 s: damagePct 92.5, 10 pellets per shot, attack speed ▼90% (cadence ≈ 10% of base SMG pulls/s). ⚑ THREE always-⚑ fields converge here: (a) pellet split-vs-merge — is 92.5% the WHOLE shot split across 10 pellets, or per-pellet (×10 = 925%/shot)? Kit-silent; a 10× damage error rides on it; read popups. (b) swap shot economy (ammo/reload during swap) — kit-silent, estimate optimistically. (c) effective swap cadence tuple (⚑ derived: base effective pulls/s × 0.1).
spec.durationSemantics: 10 s hard time bound (durationSec:10, no maxShots stated).
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast — the swap lives in k's OWN burst block, so it fires ONLY on rotations k actually bursts. The control fixture carries helm as co-B3: on helm's rotations k must NOT swap. This is the classic burstCast-vs-fullBurstEnter divergence.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Keying the swap (and riders) to fullBurstEnter — fires every team FB including helm's rotations, roughly doubling swap uptime in the control comp; and/or the ×10 per-pellet damage misread; and/or ignoring attack speed ▼90% (10× swap shot count).
spec.distinguishingAssertion: In controlComp('k') with helm co-B3: swap-flavored damage events (mult 92.5) appear ONLY in 10 s windows following k's OWN burstCast events (none after helm-only rotations); swap pull cadence ≈ 2/s (base ~20/s × 0.1), not ~20/s; per-SHOT swap damage sums to ≈0.925× final ATK (pending ⚑ popup confirmation of split).
spec.inertness: No swap damage on rotations where the fullBurstStart chain was completed by helm; base SMG cadence resumes at swap end (t+10 s).

spec.scope: casterAtkPct 63.36 — 'of the skill user's ATK' is the caster-scaled FLAT-ADD form, NOT atkPct (own-ATK %). Self-cast so caster===target, but the stat identity still matters for buff-bucket math.
spec.durationSemantics: 10 s wall-clock, aligned with the swap window.
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast (own burst only — same block as the swap).
spec.nearestWrongModel: Encoding as atkPct 63.36 (wrong bucket/interaction), or fullBurstEnter (grants the ATK on helm's rotations too), or targeting allies.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: buffApply with stat==='casterAtkPct' and value===0.6336×k.staticAtk (FLAT-RESOLVED, not 63.36) emitted only at k's burstCast frames, targetIdx===k only; absent on helm-completed rotations.
spec.inertness: No ally receives it; no application on FBs k did not cast.

spec.scope: attackDamagePct +21.12 (Damage-Up bucket), generic — stacks additively with skill2's 10.62 when both live.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Targeting all allies (the adjacent skill2 line IS team-wide — easy scope bleed) or keying to fullBurstEnter.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: buffApply stat==='attackDamagePct' value===21.12 has targetIdx===k only, at k's burstCast frames only; allies' concurrent Damage-Up shows 10.62 (skill2) without the 21.12 term.
spec.inertness: Ally damage events never carry the 21.12 contribution.

loadBearingSet: skill2:team maxAmmoPct -51.13 for 10s on stack gain
skill2:team attackDamagePct +10.62 for 10s on stack gain
notes: Three places I expect a shared-prior misread. (1) THE AMMO CUT IS THE KIT'S ENGINE: skill2's Max-ammo ▼51.13% is not a defensive footnote — it halves k's magazine after the first reload, which accelerates her lastBullet → +29-stack → skill2-refresh feedback loop (stack cap in ~4 short magazines, ~15 s), while simultaneously TAXING allies with ~2× reload downtime. A model that drops Effect 1 gets both the self-ramp speed and the ally penalty wrong; assert the first-magazine-is-120 / later-magazines-~58 shape explicitly. (2) TWO PROBABLE ENGINE GAPS: (a) the 23.9% rider is CRIT-COUNT-gated ('pellets land a critical hit 4 times') and its cadence must track a crit rate that itself ramps 0.75%×stacks and saws at FB end — the schema's hitCount counts rounds unconditionally and exposes no crit gate, so a faithful encoding may need a missing primitive or an explicitly-⚑ calibrated effective threshold; (b) both 'Removes X at Full Burst end' lines need a remove-named-buff effect that the EffectDef union does not show — verify the engine has one before calling these FAITHFUL; if absent this leans NO-GO(engine-core) rather than a quiet durationSec fudge. (3) BURST-CAST vs FB-ENTER: the control fixture's helm co-B3 makes every burst-block assertion discriminating — the swap, the 63.36% caster-ATK flat add, and the 21.12% must all be absent on helm-completed rotations. Also hold the line on the swap's ⚑ trio (pellet split vs merge = a latent 10× error; swap ammo economy; cadence = base×0.1) — kit-silent, popup-read before any magnitude is trusted. Duration semantics are uniformly wall-clock seconds here (no 'for N round(s)' lines), so durationShots should appear NOWHERE in this override.
